findings.text: The dispatch-condition branch that admits the waived form has no assertion: reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:1528 adds the waived clause to the composed done_when, but tests/test_a_waived_review_is_reachable.py exercises only _review_brief_text at line 320 and 328, so reverting lines 1528-1535 to the measured-only clause leaves all three cases green and a reviewer is again dispatched a condition that refuses the count it was told to file.

The waived clause is gated on the waiver alone while the brief block is also gated on the rubric: reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:1528 omits the figure check that line 1496 resolves and that line 968 applies to the brief, so a figure review of a waived run would be dispatched a done_when naming a form its own brief never explains.

item_verdicts.call_sites: verified recall: reckon/crew/review.py:1324 waived_failure_count_refusals, reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:1245 and :1476 brief composition, reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:3203 and :3282 dispatch, reckon/crew/dispatch_commands.py:3350 node fields
item_verdicts.diff: Read fcbaea0087d81a41f552d2e8cda3eb77ba4584d2..27776268f3aa6f3595b25561751d0212121d947f commit by commit: 9b8d09be17 fixes review.py's row-status set and adds the brief block, 847f4256e4 and 27776268f3 add only the evidence fragment, and 4da0eb94ab adds four assertions to the test file.
item_verdicts.done_when: Read the done_when in dispatch-detail.json and its three cases against tests/test_a_waived_review_is_reachable.py:298, :337 and :370; the scoped gate at head records 61 passed / EXIT=0 and the base arm records 2 failed, 1 passed / EXIT=1 in negative-control-base.log.
item_verdicts.goal: Read the source node's goal from the run's dispatch-detail.json and from docs/plans/a-gate-halts-only-on-substance.html:82; the landed change makes the waived form reachable from both directions, the brief block at reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:852 and the committed-row reader at reckon/crew/review.py:1284.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read the source manifest.md in full; it names four commits, the scoped gate and both suite arms with EXIT=0, the base control at 2 failed / EXIT=1 and the matched importer arms, and every named log was opened and carries its revision header and a bare EXIT line.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Read the node's declared write_paths from dispatch-detail.json; all four delivered paths, reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py, reckon/crew/review.py, tests/test_a_waived_review_is_reachable.py and docs/evidence/fragments/a-gate-halts-only-on-substance/a-waived-review-is-reachable.html, are inside them and the declared figure path was left unused.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_waived_review_is_reachable.py:361 reddens when WAIVER_ROW_STATUSES at reckon/crew/review.py:1226 drops 'clean' and :321 reddens when the block at recovery_review_subject.py:970 is removed, but the dispatch clause at :1528 has no assertion, so a third of the delivered behaviour is unguarded.
justifications.evidence: negative-control-base.log records 2 failed, 1 passed and EXIT=1 at fcbaea0 with the head's test file, scoped-gate-1794975994935138108.log records 61 passed and EXIT=0 at 27776268, and baseline_suite-1794976119880049837.log and after_suite-1794976194025790951.log both end EXIT=0 with 0 failures, giving added_failure_count 0 and an empty id list.
justifications.fit: The new block follows the existing composer idiom of recovery_review_subject.py:822's _reviewed_scope_block and review.py:1215's constant-plus-docstring form, and every added name states the mechanism it carries.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:970 appends the waived block to a waived run's brief and reckon/crew/review.py:1286 reads a committed row whose status is clean with a waiver_reason, which is exactly the two holes the node goal names.
justifications.reuse: The brief resolves its reason through reckon/crew/review.py:1247 recorded_suite_delta_waiver rather than reading the pointer itself, and no second reader of a recorded suite-delta waiver exists: a search over reckon/ for waiver_reason found only promotion_records.py:1475 as the writer.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in the diff, reckon/crew/review.py, reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py, tests/test_a_waived_review_is_reachable.py and the evidence fragment, is inside the four write_paths in dispatch-detail.json; the only reach beyond the plan's deliverable is the dispatch clause at recovery_review_subject.py:1528, which the deliverable's 'told in its brief' implies.
